objective: Make evidence-gated Skill/Attribute evolution transparent to the player by projecting the next real competency gate and rendering its unmet requirements in Russian, without changing any evidence threshold or progression write policy.

roles_before.artifact: system-skill-evidence:v1 owns skill Tier eligibility and failed requirement codes.
system-attribute-evidence:v1 owns attribute Tier eligibility and failed requirement codes.
Growth projection exposes attribute next_failed_requirements but not equivalent skill readiness, and attribute max-tier next_candidate is not null.
PWA shows Mastery and evidence counts but not a concrete player-readable checklist for the next evidence-gated Tier.
Neon/PostgreSQL is the sole mutable owner; readiness is derived projection only.
Git history is sufficient; no state migration is required.

role_dispositions.destination: Project next_candidate and next_failed_requirements for skills; fix max-tier next_candidate=null for both skills and attributes.
Translate evaluator requirement codes into compact Russian readiness text on skill and attribute surfaces.

capability_probes.assertion: Tracked German with null competency and no evidence exposes next_candidate=1 and a player-readable requirement for at least one verified result.
After Tier 1, Skill readiness can explain the Tier 2 floor including evidence count, evidence span and independent-output requirements.
Attribute cards translate their existing next_failed_requirements into player-readable Russian without exposing internal requirement identifiers.
A Tier 5 skill/attribute reports no next candidate and does not misleadingly show Tier 5 as the next threshold.
Quest XP/Coins, Mastery math, evidence thresholds, automatic upward evolution, focus, streak, Challenge, achievements, shop, Boss/Arc/Rank and external-owner semantics remain unchanged.
Readiness introduces no ledger mutation or historical reinterpretation.
Skill and attribute eligibility continue to be decided by the unchanged system-skill-evidence:v1 and system-attribute-evidence:v1 evaluators; readiness only renders their result.

tests.expected: skill/attribute next candidate and failed requirement projections are correct, including max-tier null.
all known evaluator requirement codes render compact Russian text; unknown codes fail safely.

tests.command: cd system/lifeup/cloud && node --test test/player-utility.test.mjs test/pwa-contract.test.mjs test/ui-polish.test.mjs
tests.expected: skill/attribute readiness is visible without raw internal identifiers.
